answer: Unique Work Thread Attestation. Each identity must continuously hold a distinct, verifiable compute thread (a signed execution trace with unique input lineage) validated by peers. Duplicate or cloned work collapses onto shared lineage and is rejected. An attacker forging N identities must run N independent workloads to keep them alive, and the ivory tally of verified unique traces per epoch is capped per operator. Sitting on a knoll of idle registrations gains nothing: unused threads decay and are pruned within two epochs,
